coverage.method: manual estimate confirmed by mutations; cargo llvm-cov not installed

findings.summary: LaunchError::Spawn is not recorded; replay keeps the pending show the live reactor cancelled
findings.suggestion: record ScratchpadShowExpired(id) on launch error, like ScratchpadMoveEnded for moves

findings.summary: hiding the app during a move wait does not cancel placement and focus on timeout
findings.suggestion: decide policy; e.g. drop pending moves of pid on ApplicationHiddenChanged(pid, true)

findings.summary: each launch still spawns an open thread; a hanging open accumulates threads
findings.suggestion: accept or skip a second open per name while one runs
